title: Orchid convention rule
description: Frontmatter of one rule file: plugins/convention-<stack>/rules/<id>.md. A rule id is permanent. Retire a rule by moving it to state 'removed'; never delete the file or reuse the id, because overrides, strikes, findings and fixtures all key on it. validate_rules.py implements the subset of draft-07 used here and fails on any keyword it does not implement.

id.description: <stack>-<category>-<NNN>. Must equal the file name without .md.

stack.description: Stack id. Must equal the pack's pack.json stack and the convention-<stack> directory. Open set: a new pack never needs a schema change.

statement.description: The rule as one or more complete sentences.

rationale.description: Why the rule exists. Overrides and retirement are argued against this text.

state.description: Only an active rule can block. Advisory and deprecated rules report without blocking; proposed and removed rules are inert.

advisory_until.description: Required for state 'advisory': the date its evidence is reviewed.

overridable.description: Whether a repo may switch the rule off in .orchid/conventions/<stack>.md. False is reserved for a short list (secrets, PII in logs). A false rule also never escalates to a human prompt in the guard.

ignorable.description: Whether an inline ignore marker is honoured. Must be false when overridable is false.

scope.description: changed-files: only the current change set is judged. full-repo: every file, every scan. Non-overridable rules must be full-repo.

method.description: regex: line-based POSIX ERE run through grep -E. lint: the pack linter's own rule. model: a whole-file judgement by the scanner.

pattern.description: Portable POSIX ERE, matched per line. No \s, \w, \d, \b or (?...): BSD and GNU grep disagree on them.

flags.description: 'i' for case-insensitive. Matching is always per line.

file_glob.description: Repo-relative glob. '**/' matches zero or more directories, '*' and '?' never cross '/'.

exclude_glob.description: Repo-relative glob of files the rule never applies to, such as test doubles.

exclude_pattern.description: Portable POSIX ERE. A matching line is not reported even when it matches pattern. Keep it narrow: it hides real hits as easily as false ones.

fragment_safe.description: True only when the rule can be decided from the new text of an edit alone. Only fragment-safe regex rules may appear in guard.json, and every one of them must.

lint_rule_id.description: The linter's identifier for the rule, when method is 'lint'.

fix.description: One-line remediation shown with a finding.
